Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one premium, ORIGINAL PIXEL ART game art-direction concept board, landscape approximately 1536x1024. The user supplied two pixel character comparison charts. Use these ONLY as aesthetic references, specifically panel 02 "16-BIT FANTASY" and panel 08 "TACTICAL RPG". Do not copy any existing character, chart layout, logo, or reference image into the result.
REQUIRED quality: intricate 16-bit fantasy / tactical JRPG pixel craftsmanship, clearly visible expressive face and eyes, separated hair locks, beautifully layered clothing or armor, selective metal highlights, confident readable silhouette, medium stylized 3.5–4.5-head proportions. All characters are clearly adults. Intentional colored outlines, crisp stepped edges, coherent visible square pixel clusters, restrained material ramps and rich hue-shifted shadows. No smooth vector art, no airbrush, no photographic detail, no 3D, no pixel-filter over a painting, no ultra-simplified 8-bit stick figures.
A coherent three-part board: left 36% a gorgeous large original full-body pixel protagonist with face clearly visible; top right 64% a wide side-view battle environment containing a smaller carefully redesigned version of the SAME protagonist and one fitting enemy, demonstrating believable in-game scale; bottom right 64% an attractive in-world rectangular 6-column x 4-row preparation matrix with a few distinct multi-cell pieces, adjacency connection marks, and four compact shop offers. The matrix is NOT a backpack or pouch, no inventory bag motif. It represents the named setting's tool, retaining grid arranging, rotating, merging and synergy. Make the board visually clear, panel hierarchy beautiful, keep combat ground and character silhouettes readable.
Show a single internally consistent pixel density, theme palette and lighting across portrait, battle scene and UI. Character art must be at least as polished and detailed as the chosen chart examples. Main character is the emotional focal point; the matrix has generous negative space. Minimal English typography only, exact top title supplied below. A small footer must read "ART CONCEPT - NOT GAME FOOTAGE". This is an aspirational art concept, not a real screenshot, not a final sprite sheet. No Chinese text, no existing game title, no extra characters or busy infographics. No backpacks.
Theme A, exact top title "A - MOONWITCH".
Setting: a moonlit city built around an abandoned celestial observatory, silver staircases, indigo wisteria, a broken astronomical orrery, high distant moon and moving clouds. Character: a beautiful adult witch-scholar, long flowing plum hair, visible warm amber eyes and graceful confident expression, sculptural midnight-purple witch hat with a thin crescent ornament, high-collared ivory blouse, layered asymmetric indigo cloak and plum skirt or fitted travel dress, precise old-gold embroidery, practical dark boots, elegant crescent staff with a sapphire star core. Fully clothed, dignified and appealing, not sexualized. Her silhouette and face should feel truly refined, not generic.
Grid carrier: a rectangular SIGIL ARRAY etched into a dark lapis-and-brass astronomical desk, a 6x4 rectangular grid inside the decorative celestial frame (not circular or radial gameplay). Pieces are long crescent blades, faceted moon crystals, protective mirror plates, healing phials and tiny star catalysts. Golden-blue directional sockets join spell pieces. Battle uses a silver-blue moonlit observatory terrace and a single lunar stone sentinel. Palette midnight violet, dusty lavender, ivory, sapphire and restrained gold. Distinct, romantic, mysterious.
